description: This file is a shell script containing tests for a Git pseudo-merge bitmap feature, including setup, traversal, threshold, pattern matching, overlap, reuse, and boundary traversal tests.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges
methods.description: Tests the correctness of pseudo-merge bitmap generation.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merge_commits
methods.description: Verifies the commits in pseudo-merge groups.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_satisfied
methods.description: Checks if pseudo-merge satisfiability conditions are met.

methods.name: tag_everything
methods.description: Creates tags for all commits in the repository.
